title: Fix: Add role and aria-checked attributes to plan / act mode switch so that screen readers can tell its state ( Resolves #4244 )
body: ### Related Issue **Issue:** #4244 ### Description When trying to change modes using a screen reader, it says "plan" or "act". However, it wasn't able to announce the on / off state due to lack of aria attributes. Also, there was a small problem that screen reader users couldn't notice that they were actually interactable, because the they were implemented with div elements without the correct role attribute. Reference: the switch role https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Roles/switch_role ### Test Procedure - As I did in my previous pull request, it consists of aria / role attributes only. It won't affect the appearance of the controls. - Tested using NVDA that the switch controls got announced "switch on plan" or "switch off plan" (same applies to act) ### Type of Change - [x] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) - [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality) - [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected) - [ ] ♻️ Refactor Changes - [ ] 💅 Cosmetic Changes - [ ] 📚 Documentation update - [ ] 🏃 Workflow Changes ### Pre-flight Checklist - [x] Changes are limited to a single feature, bugfix or chore (split larger changes into separate PRs) - [x] Tests are passing (`npm test`) and code is formatted and linted (`npm run format && npm run lint`) - [x] I have created a changeset using `npm run changeset` (required for user-facing changes) - [x] I have reviewed [contributor guidelines](https://github.com/cline/cline/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) ### Screenshots ### Additional Notes ---- > [!IMPORTANT] > Add `role` and `aria-checked` attributes to plan/act mode switch in `ChatTextArea.tsx` for screen reader accessibility. > > - **Accessibility**: > - Add `role="switch"` and `aria-checked` attributes to `SwitchOption` in `ChatTextArea.tsx` for plan/act mode switch. > - Screen readers now announce "switch on plan" or "switch off plan" for the mode switch. > - **Testing**: > - Verified with NVDA screen reader that the switch state is announced correctly. > > This description was created by [](https://www.ellipsis.dev?ref=cline%2Fcline&utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral) for f82a74e59fc5f06ced11b2417ba926d7bb05ba1c.
